Our revered Church does not permit permanent graves/crosses unlike most RC✝️Churches. However our Church recently focussed on reconditioning the Cemetery. The areas included the wall exterior, access path, flooring, fencing, numbers on the graves/niches & introducing a constant water supply line with basin. Also the main entrance gate to the complex was modified. Our Cemetery certainly appears brighter than it was before. Hence today we also remember our noble preacher & Parish Priest Fr. MICHAEL PEN who is taking very good care of his parishioners, living & dead.🙏Thanks Father!

Leroy Alphonso & family
Mira Road

featured_reviews.name: Priya Sathe
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been a part of Living Hope Church Mira Road since a year now and the excitement of coming back of church every Sunday never gets stale. The awesome presence of the Lord, the freedom to worship, the fellowship of friends and the powerful word all make up for a fruitful time spent on a Sunday morning. If you're looking for a church that feels like family this is it! Come, experience and Be Blessed..

featured_reviews.name: Arvind Sathe
featured_reviews.review_text: It has been more than a year that I have been a part of this Church. I always look forward to worship and have fellowship with other members. The presence of the Lord is evident and I'm always blessed and refreshed every time I come. The community is so varies but strongly connected. The service is bi-lingual (English and Hindi) so everyone can understand. Come and be blessed.

featured_reviews.name: jaiz joy
featured_reviews.review_text: Came during my vacation. The worship team did a wonderful job. The guest speaker Pr.Ahuja from Goa gave an amazing sermon. Felt like home. Will be back next time in town.

featured_reviews.name: Chris Gajjala
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Power of Holy Spirit is so amazing that touches each & every hearts and leads us in the presence of God.
Worship, Word, Fellowship with other members and everything is Spirit filled.

featured_reviews.name: Feba Samuel
featured_reviews.review_text: This is my favourite place to be!! It's a blessing to be a part of such a gathering where I receive so much love and warmth. If you are up for great worship and spirit filled word of God then this is the place to be!!!

featured_reviews.name: Jason Samuel
featured_reviews.review_text: In this church, everyone is made to feel welcomed, comforted, and inspired. In these little hours spent together in church, we become a family in Christ Jesus than just friends

featured_reviews.name: Jyoti Mecwan
